'''Special Operations Group Four''', more commonly known as '''Operations Group Four''', was one of five [[Operations Group|Special Operations Groups]] sent by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] into the [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Galactic War]] in hopes of locating and freeing the [[Dread Masters]]. Group Four was led by the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vandorn]] and secured a position in the [[High Security Section]] of the prison.<ref name="TOR" />
